Give the exact "Stock-based compensation expense" figure for full year 2024 and the full-year 2023 figure, plus the footnote text. Data: {{abnb_q4_2024}}

**Full-year figures (in millions):**

- **FY 2024:** Stock-based compensation expense of **$1,407**
- **FY 2023:** Stock-based compensation expense of **$1,120**
